GPT-4o

GPT-4o is OpenAI's flagship multimodal model supporting text and image inputs.

Model Specifications

  • Context Length: 128,000 tokens
  • Modalities: text, image
  • Training Cutoff: April 2024
  • Data Classification: Sensitive

Pricing

$5.00 per 1M tokens for input

$15.00 per 1M tokens for output

When to use

Use GPT-4o for complex reasoning tasks, multimodal inputs, and high-quality text generation where cost is secondary to performance.
